source_pair.english: The trailing tag states that the message was written by the posting handle ON BEHALF OF <principal>: the handle holds the pen, the principal owns ratified content once countersigned in its own voice, and obligations bind the principal only after such ratification. Expands losslessly to "this message was written by the posting handle on behalf of <principal>."
